notes.title: Update! Fix!
notes.content:
1. Added a new Health Potion crafting feature:
When using Free Cooking, you can craft a Health Potion using 20 Magic Liquids.

2. Updated the Health Potion description.

3. Fixed an issue where the audio and special effects would sometimes repeat when right-clicking to quickly upgrade a vehicle.

4. Optimized vehicle movement paths in some maps, adjusting some sudden jumps or twists.

5. Adjusted monster magic resistance values. When a monster's health bar shows armor with a certain magic element, the damage will be lower if you attack the monster without using the corresponding magic element's damage.

6. Fixed an issue where lighting sometimes rendered incorrectly in camps.

7. Fixed an issue where the Ice Dragon would sometimes not fire lasers.

notes.title: See you on September 8th! Super low launch discounts and tons of bonuses!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Our game is finally launching! No delays this time!

This is a mobile-Tower-Defense game featuring a feature where you can extend and add turrets to the back of your moving cart, making the gameplay incredibly fun and unique. Besides attacking enemies, you can also collect materials to supply your food stall between battles! In short, this is a Mobile-Tower-Defense game fused with a shop-opening simulation. We hope you enjoy it.

In addition, to celebrate the launch, we're offering a super discount of -30%! And with support from our partners, you can get even bigger discounts by purchasing the bundle!
